- Own 389DS software lifecycle: upgrade train, master fleet replication, schema management across commercial, GovCloud, ADC, China, and MVP
- Drive pipeline-driven automated region builds, eliminating manual ceremony from partition expansion
- Lead schema evolution discipline: document every attribute, analyze consumer impact end-to-end before every change
- Architect and evolve the LDAP Read Proxy: schema-routed access, expansion to BRASS and additional backends, transparent to existing callers
- Own GSAM as the system-account control plane across LDAP, POSIX, ANT : lifecycle management, credential rotation, ANT auto-provisioning, and the path to passwordless system accounts
- Own LDAP Time Machine and the Identity Data Lake: snapshot pipelines, S3 vending, cross-region log analytics, and IdP security intelligence
- Set the observability standard across every access path -direct, proxied, historical, analytical, consistent telemetry, uniform authorization
- Serve as Tier-1 on-call anchor for directory availability and replication health
- Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar across both teams
